result:
I fixed the rules whose behaviour didn't match their docstrings. After the fixes, I checked all 150 rules against a reference calculation built from their docstrings, across many qty/unit combinations, and none differ.

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 05, 16, 92 | The cap was applied to the price before the discount was computed (`min(base, cap) * pct`) | Compute the discount on the full price, then cap the discount |
| 11 | Used `qty > 50`, so exactly 50 units got no discount | Changed to `qty >= 50` |
| 19, 30, 80, 131 | Discount was rounded with `round` instead of floored | Changed to `// 100` |
| 77 | Docstring says marginal, but the discount used the full price | Changed to `(qty - 10) * unit * 12 // 100` |
| 82 | The cap only applied when the discount exceeded 200,000 | Always cap at 100,000 |

I also changed rule 47 (`>= 101` to `>= 100`) and rule 72 (`> 20` to `>= 20`) so they read like the other rules. Their results don't change, because a marginal rule gives a 0 discount at exactly the threshold quantity.

STATUS: DONE
